clause: Raster focus-stack / seamless-blend (auto-blend layers) composite op [STU-RAS-051,STU-CON-007]

scope.summary: Implement the focus-stack / seamless-blend composite operation over a multi-layer stack: auto-align (reuse existing align primitive), then per-region select and blend the sharpest/best-exposed content into one seamless masked composite (extended depth of field + seamless panorama/exposure blending). Non-destructive masked output; model-steerable command reusing auto-align, statistical-stack (STU-RAS-014), masking (STU-RAS-018), HDR/exposure (STU-RAS-033) primitives.
acceptance_criteria: auto-align + per-region sharpest/best-exposed blend -> seamless masked composite; deterministic; visually verified
expected_tests: live: focus-stack over a 3-layer stack produces a seamless masked composite; deterministic (seeded) + byte-stable on backend

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Focus stack & seamless blend

risk_if_missed: Focus-stacking/seamless-blend (a named MD/Photoshop-class op) absent despite enabling primitives existing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
